title: Evidence-First Research Methodology v1
goal: Develop and validate a reusable outer-loop research methodology for AI/software research that converts residual problems into explicit competing hypotheses, evidence-backed mechanism choices, discriminating experiments, preregistered interpretation rules, belief updates, and stopping/reopening rules. Use the Local EXTRACT research history as a read-only retrospective and live shadow case study, while keeping EXTRACT scientifically independent and deferring ontology/semantic-control integration until the methodology itself is validated.
acceptance_criteria: The methodology cleanly separates the outer scientific-reasoning loop from the existing inner engineering/execution loop.

The research state explicitly represents residuals, competing hypotheses, assumptions, mechanism families, candidate architectures, evidence, experiments, controls, gates, observations, interpretations, belief updates, stopping rules, reopening conditions, and decisions.
Experiment selection is justified by expected decision value or discriminatory power rather than architectural novelty or simple next-idea intuition.
Every experiment design freezes the question, hypotheses, controls, metrics, gates, interpretation table, and stopping rule before outcome evidence is consumed.
Retrospective replay uses only evidence available at each historical checkpoint and prevents hindsight leakage from later EXTRACT results.
Live EXTRACT usage begins in non-blocking shadow mode; the methodology does not control or delay EXTRACT until prospective evidence supports promotion.
The methodology preserves provenance and temporal supersession sufficiently for later ontology/semantic-control integration without requiring ontology-native output during methodology development.
Methodology promotion requires explicit retrospective and prospective evidence that it improves falsifiability, decision quality, or research efficiency without unacceptable coordination overhead.
Ontology integration is designed only after the methodology's conceptual model stabilizes and is executed under a separate future task.
constraints: Do not mutate research-engine-local-extract-redesign-v1, workspace-local-extract-independent-review-v1, workspace-semantic-control-hardening-v1, workspace-semantic-control-integration-v1, or research-engine while developing this methodology.
Treat EXTRACT as a read-only case study and preserve its sole scientific ownership.
Do not impose the methodology on active EXTRACT work during shadow validation.
Do not encode conclusions using future evidence during retrospective replay; each replay decision must be time-indexed to the evidence actually available then.
Do not collapse technological implementations into distinct scientific hypotheses when they share the same underlying mechanism; track mechanism-family identity explicitly.
Do not promote a failed mechanism family merely through cosmetic parameter, model, prompt, or implementation changes without new premise-changing evidence.
Do not make semantic-control, RDF, ontology, or SemanticObservationV1 a requirement for research-state representation in v0.1.
Do not promote experimental methodology artifacts into canonical procedures until validation evidence supports promotion.
